title: Remove the 304-K bus routes that duplicate the Purple Line
description: 304-K (route 2255, plus variant 2256 to KR Pura Market) runs Channasandra - Hope Farm - ITPL - Hoodi - Mahadevapura - KR Pura - Tin Factory, the same corridor as the Purple Line extension. 28 departures between 07:30 and 09:30; the Purple Line has 59 in the same window.
expected_change: Losses only, no zone gains. Close to zero city-wide. Any losses are in zones along Whitefield Main Road (Hope Farm to KR Pura) that are farther than a short walk from a Purple Line station.
